parameters.name: Base64Encoded
parameters.description: Specifies whether the data has been encoded in Base64.

parameters.name: CertRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the certificate.

parameters.name: Data
parameters.description:
The data of the Secret. The value must be a JSON array that contains the following information:

*   Key: Secret key
*   Value: Secret value

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the Secret. The name must start with a letter, and can contain digits, letters, and hyphens (-). It can be up to 63 characters in length.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The namespace of the Kubernetes cluster.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the Secret. Valid values:

*   Opaque: user-defined data type
*   kubernetes.io/tls: Transport Layer Security (TLS) certificate type

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas update-k8s-secret --cluster-id 9c28bbb9-0000-44b3-b953-54ef8a2d0be2 --name my-secret --namespace default --type Opaque --data Key_:_name_,_Value_:_william_,_Key_:_age_,_Value_:_12 --cert-id 6650277 --cert-region-id cn-hangzhou --base64-encoded false --region cn-hangzhou
